tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

question.text: Which one of the following statements for D.I. Mendeleeff, is incorrect ?

options.text: He authored the textbook - Principles of Chemistry.
At the time, he proposed Periodic Table of elements structure of atom was known.
Element with atomic number <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>101</mn></math> is named after him.

solution.text: At the time, he proposed the periodic table but structure of atom was unknown.
